lore.title: LOST ARCHIVE #{n}
lore.fragments: The same yellowed wallpaper repeats for hours. I count the lights to keep from losing it. Every third one is dead.

Empty corridor, lights steady. Nothing to report on this reel.
Keep. Nothing else to do here but keep.
The camera's monitor hisses whenever I stop moving. There's nothing nearby that could cause that kind of interference.
An empty corridor, taken with flash. Once developed, something was standing right behind me.

[unknown voice]
Testing, testing. In case anyone ever finds this.
The lights on the third floor are still holding, but not for long.
I'm keeping the recording. Just in case.

The lights dim at regular intervals, like breathing. No source found.
(Why do I keep logging this like anyone will ever read it.)
Someone is walking two corridors over. When I stop, it stops. I've only caught its silhouette so far — hunched, something round where the head should be.
My own silhouette, from behind, standing still in front of an open fuse box. I don't remember taking this.

Fuse box open, no one around. The dark is spreading from the far end of the corridor.
Flag this. Too late to flag anything now.

[unknown voice]
There's someone else down here, further in.
When I shout, it stops walking. Then it starts again, closer.
Every time it catches me, everything goes dark for a second. I wake up one floor down, empty-handed. Like the archive got reset to the start of the corridor.
Same corridor as before. Except this time, the shape behind me is a little closer.

Lens cracked, the picture still holds. The subject stays still, centered in frame, head tilted.
(note illegible, stained)

[unknown voice, barely audible]
Is it still recording?
Keep filming. Please, keep going.
So something keeps a record, at least.
I don't think it wants to hurt me. It just wants someone watching. For this to keep being recorded, all the way through.

Full shot, uncut. The corridor goes down, the lights die one by one ahead of the camera, which keeps moving on its own.
Watch in full. No cuts. No one left to cut it anyway.
lore.end: All the archives have been found. All that's left is to review them.

guide.title: GUIDE
guide.controls.1: Left stick: move. Stick click: toggle sprint.
guide.controls.2: Right stick left/right: snap turn. Click or up/down: crouch or stand.
guide.controls.3: Trigger: aim and use. Grip: grab, hold or release.
guide.controls.4: A/X: store a held item. Y: open inventory. B: flashlight.
guide.controls.5: Inventory: trigger selects or moves; grip takes an item out.
guide.controls.6: Held item: release on a slot, behind the shoulder, or use A/X to store it.
guide.controls.7: Journal: review archives and the recovery code from the inventory.
guide.controls.8: Settings: language, vignette, height and nickname.
guide.systems.1: One archive is hidden on every level. Find it to complete the story.
guide.systems.2: The exit leads to the next level. The camcorder signal shows its distance.
guide.systems.3: Battery, health and madness appear in the camcorder display.
guide.systems.4: The game saves automatically. Continue restores the last known position.
guide.systems.5: A run ending opens the score screen. Your nickname is kept after confirmation.
guide.systems.6: The Devices menu pairs a headset and restores archives, scores and saves.
guide.systems.7: Debug mode adds a test menu to the inventory.
guide.systems.8: Recalibrate height from Settings after putting on the headset.
